product_launches.description: Verifiable launched CredAgent, an autonomous AI-based credentialing agent designed to automate end-to-end healthcare provider credentialing workflows and significantly boost productivity and accuracy.

overview_description.description:
Verifiable is developing an API that will enable healthcare providers to simplify license authentication by connecting with state and federal databases. Verifiable allows users to reach hundreds of primary sources in one location, as well as next-generation tracking that automates compliance, reduces risk, and keeps patients safe.

Founded by Nicholas Macarioand Vivekanand Rajkumar in the year 2019 and is based in San Francisco, California, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Verifiable develops real-time credential verification platform intended to verify licenses, sanctions, and other important records.

product.name: Credentialing Software
product.description: Software for automating healthcare provider credentialing, including provider applications, primary source verification, workflow management, and credentialing packet generation.

product.name: CredAgent™
product.description: An autonomous AI agent for processing healthcare credentialing tasks in batches, validating provider data, documenting verification decisions, and applying configured governance rules.

product.name: CVO Services
product.description: Technology-enabled credentialing services that combine automated verifications, human file review, packet preparation, credentialing support, and audit assistance for healthcare organizations.

product.name: Provider Network Monitoring
product.description: Continuous monitoring for provider licenses, sanctions, exclusions, adverse actions, and other compliance signals, with alerts, match review, intervention workflows, and reporting.

product.name: Primary Source Verification
product.description: Real-time verification of provider licenses, identifiers, sanctions, exclusions, disciplinary actions, and related credentials using direct connections to authoritative data sources.

product.name: Provider Intake
product.description: Digital provider intake tools that collect and validate application data through CAQH and AMA integrations, dynamic forms, and secure provider portals.
